title: "invalid_result"
description: "A service's result does not match its `result` schema, or is larger than the size limit."
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mts from the website's docs. Do not edit: run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

**What happened:** A service's result does not match its `result` schema, or is larger than the size limit.

**How to fix it:** Return a value that parses with `result` (and stays under the limit); return a reference (an id or a URL) for large data.

Thrown as an `ActorKitError` (or a subclass) whose `code` is this one and whose `docs` is this page.

The error's `message` names the specifics (the message, state, binding or value involved). See all [error codes](/errors/).
